Thread-read: 7065919252
Premise: holds by the card's L2 reading (record 7065286873 on PR #36123) and the code at origin/main a5a5312ff4: `MetadataClient.publish` (`metadata-client.ts` around :1989) takes no draft-version precondition; whether every view-draft writer is unpinned is the dev's first measurement.
Pre-claim lane: repo:objectstack whole-repo lane; `ui/packages/**` (`domain:ui`); a4-F Next list (seat 03:28Z).
Prior rulings read: 7058616478 on #35955 (an existing unpublished draft is never published on someone else's behalf) — the rule this card restores. Route: the area picks direction B (client-only, no protocol face) per the card's "the card thread picks one in its premise"; direction A (a publish precondition on the `/meta` door) is a protocol change and would be its own card.
Pre-claim deps: PR #36123 (origin) merged.
Fold-or-serial: not folded; app-shell views shared with #36011 / #36244 in this area (different files expected); `overlap-check` before each push.
Serial constraints cleared: none blocking at origin/main a5a5312ff4
